subject.title: feat: nameplate attention --wait blocks until the human acknowledges

question: Should explicit `nameplate dismiss` and fail-safe teardown intentionally return `autoDismissed` and exit 3, the same result as timer expiry?
rationale: Current main defines the recovery paths but not their agent-facing acknowledgment semantics, and the previous review explicitly reserved this public CLI contract for the lifecycle owner.

options.title: Add a distinct dismissed outcome
options.body: Use a separate acknowledgment and exit code for manual or fail-safe teardown so agents can distinguish recovery from timer expiry.

options.title: Approve broad auto-dismiss semantics
options.body: Keep exit 3 for timer, manual, and fail-safe dismissal and document `autoDismissed` as any app-side non-click teardown.

recommendation.title: Add a distinct dismissed outcome
recommendation.body: Use a separate acknowledgment and exit code for manual or fail-safe teardown so agents can distinguish recovery from timer expiry.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the original attention behavior and the current recovery lifecycle whose semantics this PR exposes.
